```yml
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, 'release/**', 'feature/**']
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'

jobs:
  branch-policy:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Validate source branch naming
        env:
          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ github.head_ref }}
        run: |
          if [[ -z "$BRANCH_NAME" ]]; then
            echo "Missing head branch name from pull request context."
            exit 1
          fi

          if [[ "$BRANCH_NAME" =~ ^(feature|release|hotfix)\/[a-z0-9._-]+$ ]]; then
            echo "Branch naming check passed: $BRANCH_NAME"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Branch naming check failed: $BRANCH_NAME"
          echo "Expected one of:"
          echo "  feature/<spec-id-or-topic>"
          echo "  release/<x.y.z>"
          echo "  hotfix/<x.y.z>"
          exit 1

  conventional-commits:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Validate conventional commit messages
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          COMMITS="$(git rev-list --reverse "${BASE_SHA}..${HEAD_SHA}")"
          if [[ -z "$COMMITS" ]]; then
            echo "No commits found in PR range."
            exit 1
          fi

          INVALID=0
          REGEX='^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore|revert)(\([a-z0-9._/-]+\))?!?: .+'

          for SHA in $COMMITS; do
            SUBJECT="$(git log --format=%s -n 1 "$SHA")"
            if [[ ! "$SUBJECT" =~ $REGEX ]]; then
              echo "Invalid conventional commit: $SHA -> $SUBJECT"
              INVALID=1
            fi
          done

          if [[ "$INVALID" -ne 0 ]]; then
            echo "Conventional commit validation failed."
            echo "Format: type(scope): summary"
            echo "Allowed types: feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore|revert"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Conventional commit validation passed."

  readiness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5.0.1
      - name: Verify onboarding planning artifacts
        run: ./scripts/checks/check-onboarding-readiness.sh
      - name: Verify PRD release roadmap (§11) matches release-roadmap.json
        run: node scripts/prd/render-release-roadmap.mjs --check
      - name: Validate canonical gate manifest structure
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path

          candidates = [
              Path("docs/plans/gates/GITHUB_GATE_MATRIX.json"),
              Path("docs/workspace/plans/gates/GITHUB_GATE_MATRIX.json"),
          ]
          path = next((p for p in candidates if p.exists()), None)
          if path is None:
              raise SystemExit(
                  "Missing gate manifest (expected one of: "
                  + ", ".join(str(p) for p in candidates)
                  + ")"
              )

          data = json.loads(path.read_text())
          required = [
              "manifestVersion",
              "generatedAt",
              "owners",
              "gateProfiles",
              "gates",
              "taxonomy",
              "severityModel",
              "bypassBanRules",
          ]
          missing = [k for k in required if k not in data]
          if missing:
              raise SystemExit(f"Gate manifest missing keys: {', '.join(missing)}")

          if not data["gates"]:
              raise SystemExit("Gate manifest must include at least one gate")

          valid_stages = {"start", "end", "pre_merge", "post_merge", "nightly_self_test"}
          stages = {gate.get("stage") for gate in data["gates"]}
          absent = valid_stages - stages
          if absent:
              raise SystemExit(f"Gate manifest missing stage examples: {', '.join(sorted(absent))}")

          print("Gate manifest structure checks passed.")
          PY

  design-gate-readiness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5.0.1
      - name: Verify design-system gate artifacts and references
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          design_template="docs/workspace/templates/research-design/DESIGN.template.md"
          feature_spec="docs/workspace/templates/specs/FEATURE_SPEC.template.md"
          if [[ ! -f "$design_template" ]]; then
            echo "Missing $design_template"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ ! -f "$feature_spec" ]]; then
            feature_spec="docs/templates/specs/FEATURE_SPEC.template.md"
          fi
          if [[ ! -f "$feature_spec" ]]; then
            echo "Missing FEATURE_SPEC template (workspace or docs/templates)."
            exit 1
          fi

          # Required template sections (grep: portable on ubuntu-latest without ripgrep).
          grep -Fq "## 5. Typography" "$design_template"
          grep -Fq "### 5.1 Fluid type scale" "$design_template"
          grep -Fq "### 5.2 Breakpoint and container-query matrix" "$design_template"
          grep -Fq "### 7.1 Motion tokens" "$design_template"
          grep -Fq "### 7.3 Progressive 3D fallback specification" "$design_template"

          grep -Fq "## Component API and variant map" "$feature_spec"
          grep -Fq "## Motion and reduced-motion contract" "$feature_spec"

          # Hardening performance contract must be populated (non-empty).
          perf_populated=0
          for candidate in \
            "docs/plans/05-harden/02-performance/perf.md" \
            "docs/workspace/plans/05-harden/02-performance/perf.md" \
            "docs/workspace/plans/04-harden/perf.md"; do
            if [[ -s "$candidate" ]]; then
              perf_populated=1
              break
            fi
          done
          if [[ "$perf_populated" -ne 1 ]]; then
            echo "Performance hardening contract must exist and be non-empty. Tried:"
            echo "  docs/plans/05-harden/02-performance/perf.md"
            echo "  docs/workspace/plans/05-harden/02-performance/perf.md"
            echo "  docs/workspace/plans/04-harden/perf.md"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Prevent drift back to deleted legacy rule names (pre-NEZAM rebrand).
          if [[ -d docs/workspace/context ]] && \
            grep -RInE 'coia-orchestration\.mdc|coia-sdd-design\.mdc|coia-design-gates-pro\.mdc' docs/workspace/context; then
            echo "Found legacy COIA rule references in docs/workspace/context."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Design gate readiness checks passed."

  ai-sync-drift:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5.0.1
      - name: Verify cross-client AI sync drift
        run: |
          node scripts/check-ai-drift.js

  docs-layout-policy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5.0.1
      - name: Enforce docs/core + docs/reports layout
        run: bash scripts/checks/docs-layout-policy.sh

  automation-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5.0.1
      - name: Automation smoke (baseline wiring)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -f docs/plans/gates/GITHUB_GATE_MATRIX.json || test -f docs/workspace/plans/gates/GITHUB_GATE_MATRIX.json
          test -f scripts/checks/check-onboarding-readiness.sh
          test -f .github/workflows/ci.yml
          echo "Automation smoke passed."

  placeholder:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: readiness
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5.0.1
      - name: No-op scaffold
        run: |
          echo "Replace this job with your real toolchain (pnpm test, mise, cargo, …)."
          test -f README.md

  nightly-automation-self-test:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5.0.1
      - name: Nightly automation baseline self-test
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -f docs/plans/gates/GITHUB_GATE_MATRIX.json || test -f docs/workspace/plans/gates/GITHUB_GATE_MATRIX.json
          test -f scripts/checks/check-onboarding-readiness.sh
          test -f .github/workflows/ci.yml
          echo "Nightly automation self-test baseline passed."

  policy-gate:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [branch-policy, conventional-commits, readiness, design-gate-readiness, ai-sync-drift, docs-layout-policy, automation-smoke]
    steps:
      - name: Confirm governance checks passed
        run: echo "Branch naming, commit policy, and readiness checks passed."
```
</details></tool-use>

name: NEZAM Nightly Automation
on:

    steps:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Enforce docs layout policy:
#   - Forbid legacy top-level doc trees
#   - docs/reports/ must contain only recognised category sub-folders (no loose files, no README)
#   - docs/prd/ must contain only PRD.md (no extra loose files)
#   - docs/plans/ must be empty or contain only .gitkeep
set -euo pipefail

fail=0

# Forbidden legacy roots.
for legacy in docs/context docs/plan docs/required docs/core docs/reference docs/workspace; do
  if [[ -e "$legacy" ]]; then
    echo "FAIL: legacy path must not exist: $legacy"
    fail=1
  fi
done

# Reports at wrong location.
for bad in docs/TEST_MATRIX.md docs/PROGRESS_REPORT.latest.md; do
  if [[ -f "$bad" ]]; then
    echo "FAIL: report must not live at $bad (use docs/reports/<category>/)"
    fail=1
  fi
done

# docs/reports/ — only recognised category sub-folders, no loose files at root.
if [[ -d docs/reports ]]; then
  for entry in docs/reports/*; do
    [[ -e "$entry" ]] || continue
    base="$(basename "$entry")"
    if [[ -f "$entry" ]]; then
      echo "FAIL: docs/reports must not contain loose files (move under a category/): $base"
      fail=1
      continue
    fi
    case "$base" in
      a11y|audits|coverage|html|lighthouse|perf|progress|security|tests) ;;
      *)
        echo "FAIL: unknown docs/reports category: $base (allowed: a11y audits coverage html lighthouse perf progress security tests)"
        fail=1
        ;;
    esac
  done
fi

# docs/plans/ — must be empty or contain only .gitkeep / sub-phase directories.
if [[ -d docs/plans ]]; then
  for entry in docs/plans/*; do
    [[ -e "$entry" ]] || continue
    base="$(basename "$entry")"
    if [[ -f "$entry" && "$base" != ".gitkeep" ]]; then
      echo "FAIL: docs/plans must not contain loose files (found: $base). Plans are scaffolded by /plan."
      fail=1
    fi
  done
fi

if [[ "$fail" -ne 0 ]]; then
  echo
  echo "Docs layout policy failed."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Docs layout policy passed."
```
</details></tool-use>

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Planning readiness for CI. Constitution (`docs/CONSTITUTION.md`) is intentionally optional —
# scaffold with `/CREATE constitution` when invariants matter; do not gate `/PLAN` on it here.
#
# Portable: uses only grep/find/python3 (no ripgrep) so ubuntu-latest runners pass without extra packages.
set -euo pipefail

hardlock_paths_file="docs/nezam/core/hardlock-paths.json"

read_json_string() {
  local file="$1"
  local key="$2"
  python3 - <<'PY' "$file" "$key"
import json,sys
path=sys.argv[1]
key=sys.argv[2]
obj=json.load(open(path,'r',encoding='utf-8'))
cur=obj
for part in key.split('.'):
  if part not in cur:
    raise SystemExit(2)
  cur=cur[part]
if not isinstance(cur,str):
  raise SystemExit(3)
print(cur)
PY
}

read_json_array() {
  local file="$1"
  local key="$2"
  python3 - <<'PY' "$file" "$key"
import json,sys
path=sys.argv[1]
key=sys.argv[2]
obj=json.load(open(path,'r',encoding='utf-8'))
cur=obj
for part in key.split('.'):
  cur=cur[part]
if not isinstance(cur,list):
  raise SystemExit(3)
for x in cur:
  if isinstance(x,str):
    print(x)
PY
}

if [[ ! -f "$hardlock_paths_file" ]]; then
  echo "Missing hardlock path registry: $hardlock_paths_file"
  echo "Create it first to configure required paths."
  exit 1
fi

prd_path="$(read_json_string "$hardlock_paths_file" "intake.prd" || true)"
prompt_path="$(read_json_string "$hardlock_paths_file" "intake.projectPrompt" || true)"
gate_manifest_path="$(read_json_string "$hardlock_paths_file" "planning.gateManifest" || true)"
changelog_path="$(read_json_string "$hardlock_paths_file" "planning.changelog" || true)"
versioning_path="$(read_json_string "$hardlock_paths_file" "planning.versioning" || true)"
plans_root="$(read_json_string "$hardlock_paths_file" "subphasePrompts.plansRoot" || true)"
task_glob="$(read_json_string "$hardlock_paths_file" "subphasePrompts.taskFileGlob" || true)"

if [[ -z "$prd_path" || -z "$prompt_path" || -z "$gate_manifest_path" || -z "$changelog_path" || -z "$versioning_path" || -z "$plans_root" || -z "$task_glob" ]]; then
  echo "Invalid hardlock path registry: missing required keys."
  exit 1
fi

missing=0
changelog_missing=0

required_files=(
  "$prd_path"
  "$prompt_path"
  "$gate_manifest_path"
  "$versioning_path"
)

for file in "${required_files[@]}"; do
  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then
    echo "Missing required onboarding artifact: $file"
    missing=1
  fi
done

if [[ ! -f "$changelog_path" ]]; then
  changelog_missing=1
fi

# PRD quality gate: block obvious template/placeholder PRDs (avoid false positives on words like "templates/").
if [[ -f "$prd_path" ]]; then
  prd_file="$prd_path"
  if grep -qiE 'lorem ipsum|\{\{|fill in the blank|placeholder-only|\bTBD:\s*(here|replace|fixme)\b|^# .*\(draft template\)' "$prd_file"; then
    echo "PRD appears template/placeholder-based: $prd_file"
    echo "Please complete PRD content before planning is unlocked."
    missing=1
  fi
fi

# PRD <-> PROJECT_PROMPT alignment gate.
if [[ -f "$prd_path" && -f "$prompt_path" ]]; then
  prd_file="$prd_path"
